title: hydrocotyle hookeri subsp. handelii
intro: Hydrocotyle hookeri subsp. handelii, commonly known as Indian Pennywort, is a plant species within the family Apiaceae, which is native to the Indian subcontinent. Indian Pennywort is known for its potential health benefits, including the ability to improve cognitive function, enhance memory, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Indian Pennywort include its anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective properties, making it a potential treatment for various neurological disorders. The bioactive constituents of Indian Pennywort include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
